name: design-helper
description: Settle design decisions by eye, one at a time: every candidate is drawn on your real screens side by side and you pick. Six skills: values and layouts (applied to code), a design system, syncing it to code, feature UX flows, icon sets and logos, and library motion (GSAP, Motion).

interface.shortDescription: Settle design decisions by eye, one at a time
interface.longDescription: Instead of describing options in prose or handing over a finished design, these skills draw every candidate for one decision on your real screens, side by side, and you pick a letter in chat. design-helper settles one value or layout and applies it to your code. design-system, design-ux, design-brand and design-motion record decisions about the design system, a feature's flow, icons and logos, and library motion; design-sync brings the record into the code. Replies and sheet labels are in Korean by default.
defaultPrompt: Show me 5 versions of the button radius
Use $design-ux to decide how this feature should work
Use $design-motion to decide how this moment should move
